color.note: Light is the primary theme; dark overrides every token. Money colours never carry meaning alone: every amount also has a sign (+/−) or a label (you owe, you lent).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and the content area.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, top bar, tables, modals. Light mode pairs it with a 1px border; dark mode relies on the step from bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Selected segment, floating stat card, popovers, inputs inside a card in dark mode.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Search field, inner stat tiles, table header row.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Chips, secondary buttons, inputs at rest, chart baselines, switch off-track.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and table rows; progress-bar track.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and neutral amounts (what an expense cost) on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, captions, axis labels, notes under amounts. 4.9:1 on bg (light), 7:1 on surface (dark).

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholder dashes only — never for information.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand violet. Primary buttons, FAB, selected chips, progress fill, today's bar. Same in both themes so white text keeps 5.2:1.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Violet text and icons on surfaces: links, active tab, selected segment label, chart line.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary-button fill, focus ring, helper chips, budget-ring track. Text on it is primary-text.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, hero and sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Web sidebar background. Dark mode deepens it so it doesn't glow next to dark surfaces.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Active nav item fill inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: Hero net-balance card, group header, Premium header, settle-up transfer card.

tokens.name: hero-tile
tokens.usage: Inner tiles, ghost buttons and decorative rings on hero and sidebar.

tokens.name: owed
tokens.usage: Money owed to you / you lent / received. Prefix + on net figures. 4.9:1 on white, 9.8:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: owed-soft
tokens.usage: Settled/received badge and success panels; text on it is owed.

tokens.name: owe
tokens.usage: Money you owe / you borrowed. Prefix − on net figures. Also the notification dot.

tokens.name: owe-soft
tokens.usage: Owes / pending badge and warning alerts.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Text inside a warning alert on owe-soft.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Selected activity filter chip, chart tooltip, Upgrade banner.

tokens.name: chart-positive
tokens.usage: Diverging bars: owes you side; owed share of the split bar.

tokens.name: chart-negative
tokens.usage: Diverging bars: you owe side; any budget bar at 80% or more; over-budget months.

tokens.name: chart-bar-muted
tokens.usage: Non-highlighted bars (other days, group totals behind your share).

tokens.name: avatar-you
tokens.usage: The signed-in user's avatar. Always violet.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero balances and expense totals. Tabular figures.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Split total, month spend, budget ring centre.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card and section titles, modal headers.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: List titles, group names, button labels (14–16px).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, segmented items, secondary labels, table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under titles, axis labels.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Notes under amounts, badges, nav labels on mobile.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section dividers (TODAY, ACCOUNT) and table headers (11px).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stat tiles; mobile side padding (16–20).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop content side padding; top-bar side padding.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Stepper buttons, chart bar tops, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Small tiles, compact buttons, date chips.

tokens.name: radius-14
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, nav items, 44px category tiles, segmented track, web buttons.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: Inputs, large tiles, alerts on web.

tokens.name: radius-18
tokens.usage: Primary CTA (56px), list cards, hero inner tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges' fully round variant, switches, avatars.

shadow.note: Light mode: borders, with shadows on only the hero, floating card, primary CTA, FAB and modal. Dark mode: surface steps instead — shadows become deeper and quieter.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Floating stat card overlapping the group header.

layout.note: Web shell sizes and breakpoints. Breakpoints are container widths of the app root.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar. Collapses to 84px rail at ≤1180px, to a top icon row at ≤720px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the content column.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target for any control.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: At or below: icon rail, 2-column grids, 24px padding.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: At or below: single column, 16px padding, icons-only actions.
